$comment: Read by an external, project-agnostic tier runner -- not owned by this repo. One tier: light mirrors the deploy workflow's build step (npm ci, then a full quartz build), which is the only check that catches a broken page, a bad wikilink target or a malformed frontmatter block before it reaches the published site. No services, no browser. The full (non-slim) node image is required: the quartz CLI shells out to git at import time and crashes when the binary is missing.
